environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed behind an envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) in an ECS Fargate task. The envoy configuration includes a Lua filter in the HTTP connection manager that appends response headers. Specifically, the filter injects a Content-Security-Policy header with the directive: script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'. The envoy listener is bound to port 8443 and routes to the upstream actix service on localhost:8080. Note: the CSP does NOT include 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval', and does not specify any nonce or hash-based allowlisting. The envoy Lua filter runs in the response path (envoy.filters.http.lua with inline_code in the response_headers phase). The ECS task networking uses awsvpc mode so the envoy sidecar is the only ingress point - there is no way to reach port 8080 directly from outside the task ENI.
